# Vertical text test fonts

These tiny synthetic fonts are copied unchanged from the published fontcore
0.0.14 package (`tests/fixtures`). They contain test geometry, not production
typefaces. Their upstream test-code license is MIT; see `LICENSE-fontcore`.
Tests require neither installed fonts, downloads nor Python/fontTools.

Upstream repository: https://github.com/mith-mmk/FontReader
Package: https://crates.io/crates/fontcore/0.0.14
